source/_posts > title-clown.md uses layout `clown`

author: ghost

comments.body:
@rabas007 

As far as I know, it's possible by theme customization.
For example.

```ejs
<% if (post.layout === "alpha") { %>
  alpha layout...
<% } else if (post.layout === "clown") { %>
  clown layout...
<% } %>
```

Prefix filename with `_` and the files will be ignored. If you want to write a plugin, I recommend you write a new **generator** plugin and disable the default generator in `_config.yml`.

``` yaml
exclude_generator:
- post
```

title: archive页面的日期导航？
body:
hexo 1.0.9

[del]Archives页面会直接显示文章的全部内容（像首页那样）而非像zespia.tw的Archives页面那样只显示标题。[/del]
翻了翻前面closed issue找到解决方案了……这个东西最好还是写到文档里吧，感觉好多东西文档里都没写，包括参数的意义之类的。

另外对Archives页面有一点疑问，从功能上讲它应该是按时间显示时间段内的文章标题的。看目录结构hexo生成了archives/2012这样结构的文件夹供访问，但是实际上好像没有哪个链接能够指向这个目录？我没看到有年历之类的东西存在的样子……侧边栏也没有常见的Archives边栏挂件的说。

——————————
还有几个小问题是使用上的，不值得单开issue一起问了吧：
1.如何实现像zespia.tw上那样首页只显示文章的部分内容？分割用的tag是什么？
2.分类写在.md文件里和在posts文件夹里的形式是不是并无不同也可以共存？
3.__config.yml里的categories_map和tags_map选项是做什么用的？具体书写格式是怎样？文档中并没有详细写，另外我完全不填写似乎并不影响分类功能的工作。
author: zodiacg

comments.body:
看來之後得將文件寫得更詳細點了（笑）

以下是問題的回答：
1. 沒有寫年曆 widget 只是因為懶得寫而已，未來可能會寫一個 helper 便於主題開發。
2. 分割用的 tag 是`<!-- more -->`，和 WordPress、Octopress 相同
3. md 中的分類和分類文件夾可以並存，分類文件夾的優先度較高
4. categories_map 和 tags_map 是用來覆蓋預設分類 / 標籤的網址的，也就是分類 / 標籤別名。書寫方法如下：
   
   ``` yaml
   tags_map:
       遊戲: games
   ```
   
   原本的 `tags/遊戲/` 就會變成 `tags/games/`，所以不寫也沒差。

我懂了……一开始以为分类和标签需要在categories_map和tags_map里预先定义，我还想这不累死了=v=后来发现没填写也完全可以跑起来，就比较迷茫了。
哦了，谢谢您的回复

title: Make swig optional for certain files?
body:
I understand that swig is required for tag plugins as added in eb9f0c7e. However, when my markdown document contains barely:

```
   {{\foo}}
```

(I happened to have something like this in one of my blog post about TeX, in which `{` and `\` are used quite often, but note that I put this code block in a 4 spaces indention which means the Markdown processor should output that code block as is)

It will trigger the following error:

```
if ((typeof _context !== "undefined" && typeof _context.\foo !== "undefined")
                                                          ^
SyntaxError: Unexpected token ILLEGAL
    at Object.Function (unknown source)
    at createRenderFunc (/usr/local/share/npm/lib/node_modules/hexo/node_modules/swig/lib/swig.js:45:10)
    at createTemplate (/usr/local/share/npm/lib/node_modules/hexo/node_modules/swig/lib/swig.js:97:14)
    at getTemplate (/usr/local/share/npm/lib/node_modules/hexo/node_modules/swig/lib/swig.js:125:20)
    at Object.exports.compile (/usr/local/share/npm/lib/node_modules/hexo/node_modules/swig/lib/swig.js:187:14)
    at load (/usr/local/share/npm/lib/node_modules/hexo/lib/processor/load.js:68:25)
    at _asyncMap (/usr/local/share/npm/lib/node_modules/hexo/node_modules/async/lib/async.js:190:13)
    at async.forEach (/usr/local/share/npm/lib/node_modules/hexo/node_modules/async/lib/async.js:94:25)
    at _asyncMap (/usr/local/share/npm/lib/node_modules/hexo/node_modules/async/lib/async.js:187:17)
    at async.parallel.results (/usr/local/share/npm/lib/node_modules/hexo/node_modules/async/lib/async.js:459:34)
```

Because swig incorrectly considered `\foo` as a variable but it's not. Similar problem can happen to any code block with `{{}}`.

My question is: how do we input a code block with `{{}}`? I guess we should either escape it before sending to `swig.compile()` or allow to turn swig off for document like this. Any idea?
author: jjgod

comments.body:
No, it doesn't work. Try yourself with something like:

```
{{ raw }}
    \newcommand{\zh}[1]{{\zhfont #1}}
{{ endraw }}
```

In your .md, you will still get error like:

```
if ((typeof _context !== "undefined" && typeof _context.\zhfont #1 !== "undefi
```


---

Should be `{% raw %}` and `{% endraw %}` instead :) Worth to add this into hexo's documentation?
